title: Collector Pressure Lab
user: A self-hosting engineer running OpenTelemetry who needs to know whether a collector configuration will queue, shed, or overload under bursty telemetry before a production incident.
smallest_useful_product: CLI loads a Collector config and a bounded OTLP/OTLP-like traffic sample, replays configurable bursts against a local collector, records queue/latency/drop behavior, and emits tuning hypotheses.
success_measure: For a controlled slow-exporter fixture, it correctly classifies backpressure versus drops and reports the threshold within 20% of measured throughput.
constraints: Default to loopback-only test endpoints; keep telemetry samples local; warn that synthetic results are not production capacity guarantees; honor OpenTelemetry component licenses.
